description: AbstractTransformer class providing common functionality for model transformation within the Goteo project, including key management, label retrieval, URL generation, and accessors for model properties.

classes.name: AbstractTransformer
classes.description: An abstract class that implements TransformerInterface, providing common utilities for transforming models into arrays with extended capabilities such as label management, URL generation, and property access.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the transformer with a model and optional keys.

methods.name: rebuild
methods.description: Populates the object with its key properties using getter methods.

methods.name: getModelClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the associated model.

methods.name: getModelName
methods.description: Returns the basename of the model class in lowercase.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Sets the user context for the transformer.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves the current user object.

methods.name: setKeys
methods.description: Sets the keys to be used for rebuilding.

methods.name: getKeys
methods.description: Retrieves the current set of keys.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Fetches a label for a given key based on localization.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Gets the value of a key if it exists in the object.

methods.name: getRawValue
methods.description: Directly returns the raw property value from the model.

methods.name: getApiProperty
methods.description: Constructs an API URL for modifying a property.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the model's ID.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the model's name or title.

methods.name: getLink
methods.description: Returns a URL for the model, default implementation returns empty.

methods.name: getImage
methods.description: Returns a link to the model's image with specified dimensions.

methods.name: getIcon
methods.description: Returns the link to the model's icon.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the model's title.

methods.name: getSubTitle
methods.description: Returns the model's subtitle.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns a formatted date from the model.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Provides action URLs based on user permissions.

methods.name: getLangs
methods.description: Retrieves available language options for the model.

methods.name: getActive
methods.description: Indicates whether the model is active.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the order value of the model.

methods.name: getCity
methods.description: Returns the city associated with the model.
